title: The Guard Is Frozen
setup: Your rook on a4 stares straight up the a-file at the black bishop, and at the king behind it.
hint: The rook on b5 has exactly one defender. Before you count material, ask whether that defender may move at all.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{cxb5}} wins a whole rook. The bishop on **a6** is the only piece guarding b5, and your rook on **a4** pins it to the king on **a7**. Stepping aside would leave the king in check, so the recapture is not a legal move.
